last_price.title: Current Price
last_price.what_measures: Latest BTC spot close used as the canonical price reference.
last_price.price_relation: Directly represents the current traded price.
last_price.cross_family_relation: Anchors CVD, OI, volatility, liquidation and liquidity interpretation.
last_price.interpretation: Read together with change, volume and volatility to avoid interpreting a price level without context.

change_24h.title: Change 24H
change_24h.what_measures: Percentage change versus the price approximately 24 hours earlier.
change_24h.price_relation: Positive means appreciation; negative means depreciation.
change_24h.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD direction, OI change and liquidations to identify participation behind the move.
change_24h.interpretation: Large changes with weak flow confirmation can indicate fragile movement.

change_15m.title: Change 15M
change_15m.what_measures: Short-horizon percentage price change over 15 minutes.
change_15m.cross_family_relation: Useful beside CVD/order flow and short-term liquidation pressure.
change_15m.interpretation: Treat as short-horizon context, not a standalone signal.

change_4h.title: Change 4H
change_4h.what_measures: Percentage change over the previous four hours.
change_4h.cross_family_relation: Compare with volatility regime and broader positioning.
change_4h.interpretation: Confirms whether short-term movement is aligned with a larger move.

high_24h.title: High 24H
high_24h.what_measures: Highest traded price in the completed 24-hour observation window.
high_24h.price_relation: Defines the recent upper price extreme.
high_24h.cross_family_relation: Useful with resistance, liquidation clusters and volatility.
high_24h.interpretation: Repeated tests near the high can indicate pressure on the recent upper range.

low_24h.title: Low 24H
low_24h.what_measures: Lowest traded price in the completed 24-hour observation window.
low_24h.price_relation: Defines the recent lower price extreme.
low_24h.cross_family_relation: Useful with support, liquidation clusters and volatility.
low_24h.interpretation: Repeated tests near the low can indicate pressure on the recent lower range.

volume_24h.title: Volume 24H
volume_24h.what_measures: Total BTC spot notional traded in the 24-hour window.
volume_24h.price_relation: Volume does not set direction but indicates participation behind price movement.
volume_24h.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD, relative volume and liquidity.
volume_24h.interpretation: Large price moves with elevated volume generally have stronger participation.

relative_volume_20.title: Relative Volume
relative_volume_20.what_measures: Current volume divided by its recent 20-bar baseline.
relative_volume_20.price_relation: Values above 1 mean activity above its local norm.
relative_volume_20.cross_family_relation: Helps validate CVD impulses, breakouts and liquidation-driven moves.
relative_volume_20.interpretation: Use it to distinguish active moves from low-participation drift.

volume_zscore_20.title: Volume Z-Score
volume_zscore_20.what_measures: Standardized deviation of current volume from the recent 20-bar baseline.
volume_zscore_20.price_relation: Extreme positive values indicate unusually strong activity.
volume_zscore_20.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD, volatility and liquidation spikes.
volume_zscore_20.interpretation: A high z-score highlights exceptional participation rather than direction.

market_cap.title: Market Cap
market_cap.what_measures: External BTC market capitalization estimate from Glassnode.
market_cap.price_relation: Changes mainly with BTC price when circulating supply moves slowly.
market_cap.cross_family_relation: Provides macro scale context rather than intraday direction.
market_cap.interpretation: Use as structural context, not as an entry signal.

volatility_atr_percent.title: Volatility (ATR %)
volatility_atr_percent.what_measures: ATR expressed as a percentage of current BTC price.
volatility_atr_percent.price_relation: Higher values mean wider typical price movement.
volatility_atr_percent.cross_family_relation: Compare with volatility regime, liquidity stress and liquidation pressure.
volatility_atr_percent.interpretation: Higher ATR implies larger expected bar movement and wider risk ranges.

range_percent.title: Candle Range %
range_percent.what_measures: Current candle high-low span as a percentage of price.
range_percent.price_relation: Measures immediate realized movement inside the bar.
range_percent.cross_family_relation: Compare with ATR, volume and order-flow imbalance.
range_percent.interpretation: An expanding range with strong participation indicates active repricing.

price_ohlcv.title: Prices / OHLCV
price_ohlcv.what_measures: Open, high, low, close and volume representation of BTC spot price.
price_ohlcv.price_relation: This is the canonical price layer against which all other families are interpreted.
price_ohlcv.cross_family_relation: CVD explains aggressive flow, OI leverage participation, volatility movement regime, liquidations forced flow and liquidity available depth.
price_ohlcv.interpretation: Read candle structure together with volume and upstream indicators; HMI only renders Processing outputs.

macd.title: MACD
macd.what_measures: Difference between fast and slow exponential trends plus its signal line.
macd.cross_family_relation: Compare with price structure and CVD confirmation.
macd.interpretation: Crosses are directional momentum events, not guaranteed reversals.

rsi.title: RSI
rsi.what_measures: Wilder RSI momentum oscillator. Its overbought/oversold bands are dynamically precomputed from 20%/80% of the observed RSI range.
rsi.price_relation: Extreme observed-range states identify locally stretched momentum.
rsi.cross_family_relation: Compare with price structure, CVD and volatility before interpreting extremes.
rsi.interpretation: States are OVERSOLD, NORMAL BEARISH, NORMAL BULLISH or OVERBOUGHT; thresholds come from Processing, never HMI.

tsi.title: TSI
tsi.what_measures: Double-smoothed momentum oscillator. Its bands are dynamically precomputed from 20%/80% of the observed TSI range.
tsi.price_relation: Separates stretched momentum from normal bullish/bearish regions.
tsi.cross_family_relation: Useful with MACD, CVD and price trend.
tsi.interpretation: States use the observed TSI range; no fixed ±25 thresholds are used.

adx.title: ADX / DI
adx.what_measures: ADX measures trend strength while DI+ and DI- provide direction.
adx.price_relation: Rising ADX means directional structure is strengthening, regardless of side.
adx.cross_family_relation: Combine with price trend and CVD to determine whether participation confirms direction.
adx.interpretation: DI crosses provide direction; ADX provides strength.

stochastic.title: Stochastic
stochastic.what_measures: Position of the close within the recent high-low range using %K and %D.
stochastic.price_relation: Values below 20 are the buy-event zone; values above 80 are the sell-event zone.
stochastic.cross_family_relation: Compare with price structure and momentum.
stochastic.interpretation: A green arrow is permitted only for a bullish K/D cross with both values <=20; red only for a bearish cross with both >=80.

williams_r.title: Williams %R
williams_r.what_measures: Momentum position of price within the recent high-low range.
williams_r.price_relation: Values near 0 are near recent highs; values near -100 are near recent lows.
williams_r.cross_family_relation: Compare with Stochastic and price structure.
williams_r.interpretation: Use extremes as context, not as automatic reversal signals.

cci.title: CCI
cci.what_measures: Deviation of typical price from its moving statistical baseline.
cci.price_relation: Large positive/negative values indicate unusually strong displacement.
cci.cross_family_relation: Compare with trend, volatility and volume.
cci.interpretation: Persistent extremes can accompany trends, so avoid treating them as automatic reversal points.

atr.title: ATR
atr.what_measures: Average True Range measures realized price range including gaps between closes and ranges.
atr.price_relation: Higher ATR means larger typical movement, not a directional bias.
atr.cross_family_relation: Feeds volatility context and risk sizing alongside liquidity conditions.

wasserstein_distance.title: Wasserstein Distance
wasserstein_distance.what_measures: Distance between the recent return distribution and the immediately preceding reference distribution.
wasserstein_distance.price_relation: Higher values mean the statistical shape of returns is changing.
wasserstein_distance.cross_family_relation: Links Prices with volatility/regime analysis and can flag distribution shifts before simple averages change.
wasserstein_distance.interpretation: A rise indicates regime/distribution change; it is not bullish or bearish by itself.

mfi.title: MFI
mfi.what_measures: Money Flow Index combines price and volume to estimate buying/selling pressure.
mfi.price_relation: Extreme values indicate locally stretched money flow.
mfi.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD and volume participation.
mfi.interpretation: Use as confirmation of pressure rather than a standalone trigger.

bollinger_band_width.title: Bollinger Band Width
bollinger_band_width.what_measures: Relative distance between upper and lower Bollinger bands.
bollinger_band_width.price_relation: Expansion indicates increasing realized dispersion; compression indicates contraction.
bollinger_band_width.cross_family_relation: Compare with ATR and Wasserstein for volatility/regime change.
bollinger_band_width.interpretation: Compression can precede expansion but does not determine direction.

delta_4h.title: Delta 4H
delta_4h.what_measures: Net aggressive buy notional minus aggressive sell notional accumulated over the 4-hour flow window.
delta_4h.price_relation: Positive delta supports upward price pressure; negative delta supports downward pressure, but absorption can create divergence.
delta_4h.cross_family_relation: Compare with Open Interest, Liquidations and Liquidity to distinguish directional participation from absorption or deleveraging.
delta_4h.interpretation: A large delta with little price response suggests absorption; delta aligned with price suggests directional confirmation.

buy_sell_ratio_4h.title: Buy / Sell Ratio
buy_sell_ratio_4h.what_measures: Ratio between aggressive buy and aggressive sell flow in the 4-hour window.
buy_sell_ratio_4h.price_relation: Above 1 indicates buyer aggression dominates; below 1 indicates seller aggression dominates.
buy_sell_ratio_4h.cross_family_relation: Use with Spot/Futures CVD and liquidity depth to judge whether aggression can move price.
buy_sell_ratio_4h.interpretation: Extreme ratios are more meaningful when volume is high and price responds in the same direction.

futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_4h.title: Futures vs Spot Volume Ratio
futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_4h.what_measures: Relative traded notional in perpetual/futures flow versus spot flow over the same 4-hour window.
futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_4h.price_relation: High derivatives dominance can amplify moves and reversals through leverage; stronger spot participation usually gives cleaner cash-market confirmation.
futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_4h.cross_family_relation: Compare with Open Interest, Funding and Liquidations for leverage context.
futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_4h.interpretation: High futures dominance plus rising OI can indicate leveraged participation; high ratio with falling OI can indicate deleveraging.

flow_efficiency_4h.title: Flow Efficiency
flow_efficiency_4h.what_measures: How efficiently signed aggressive flow translates into directional movement instead of being absorbed or offset.
flow_efficiency_4h.price_relation: Higher efficiency means price responds more consistently to order-flow direction; low efficiency implies absorption/chop.
flow_efficiency_4h.cross_family_relation: Use with Liquidity depth and whale persistence to identify why flow is or is not moving price.
flow_efficiency_4h.interpretation: Low efficiency during large delta can warn of absorption; rising efficiency can confirm a directional impulse.

vwap_4h.title: VWAP 4H
vwap_4h.what_measures: Volume-weighted average execution price derived from the 4-hour footprint/order-flow window.
vwap_4h.price_relation: Price above VWAP indicates trading above the recent volume-weighted cost basis; below indicates trading under it.
vwap_4h.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD direction and liquidity walls to see whether flow is accepted above/below the recent cost basis.
vwap_4h.interpretation: Treat VWAP as contextual fair-value reference, not a standalone entry signal.

order_flow_imbalance_4h.title: Order Flow Imbalance
order_flow_imbalance_4h.what_measures: Normalized difference between aggressive buy and sell participation over the 4-hour window.
order_flow_imbalance_4h.price_relation: Positive values indicate buy-side aggression; negative values indicate sell-side aggression.
order_flow_imbalance_4h.cross_family_relation: Cross-check with CVD, price response and liquidation pressure.
order_flow_imbalance_4h.interpretation: Persistent imbalance aligned with price is confirmation; imbalance against price can indicate absorption or divergence.

spot_delta_4h.title: Spot Delta 4H
spot_delta_4h.what_measures: Signed aggressive order-flow delta from the spot market only.
spot_delta_4h.price_relation: Shows whether cash-market aggressors are net buyers or sellers.
spot_delta_4h.cross_family_relation: Compare directly with Futures Delta and Open Interest to separate spot-led moves from leverage-led moves.
spot_delta_4h.interpretation: Spot-led delta is usually stronger confirmation when price follows it.

futures_delta_4h.title: Futures Delta 4H
futures_delta_4h.what_measures: Signed aggressive order-flow delta from perpetual/futures markets only.
futures_delta_4h.price_relation: Shows leveraged-market buying or selling pressure.
futures_delta_4h.cross_family_relation: Read with Funding, Open Interest and Liquidations to determine whether the pressure represents position building or forced unwinds.
futures_delta_4h.interpretation: Large futures delta without spot confirmation can be fragile or leverage-driven.

flow_persistence_4h.title: Flow Persistence 4H
flow_persistence_4h.what_measures: Degree to which signed order-flow keeps the same direction through the 4-hour window.
flow_persistence_4h.price_relation: High positive or negative persistence supports sustained directional pressure; low persistence suggests alternating flow.
flow_persistence_4h.cross_family_relation: Use with trend, volatility and liquidity conditions to judge whether the move is durable.
flow_persistence_4h.interpretation: Persistent flow is more informative than a single large impulse when price is trending.

delta_zscore.title: Delta Z-Score
delta_zscore.what_measures: Standardized current signed delta relative to its recent distribution for the selected market and timeframe.
delta_zscore.price_relation: Large positive/negative z-scores identify statistically unusual buy/sell aggression.
delta_zscore.cross_family_relation: Compare with volatility and liquidation intensity to distinguish normal activity from event-driven flow.
delta_zscore.interpretation: Extreme z-score plus aligned price response can signal impulse; extreme z-score with weak response suggests absorption.

cvd_slope.title: CVD Slope
cvd_slope.what_measures: Current direction and rate of change of CVD, with acceleration as a secondary measure.
cvd_slope.price_relation: Positive slope indicates accumulating net aggressive buying; negative slope indicates net aggressive selling.
cvd_slope.cross_family_relation: Compare with price slope and Spot/Futures divergence.
cvd_slope.interpretation: Slope confirms directional flow; acceleration shows whether that pressure is strengthening or fading.

price_cvd_divergence.title: Price / CVD Divergence
price_cvd_divergence.what_measures: Difference between normalized price direction and CVD direction for the selected market/timeframe.
price_cvd_divergence.price_relation: A divergence means price and aggressive flow are not confirming each other.
price_cvd_divergence.cross_family_relation: Use with liquidity, OI and liquidations to identify absorption, leverage effects or exhaustion.
price_cvd_divergence.interpretation: Positive/negative divergence is contextual; the key is whether price continues despite opposing flow or eventually mean-reverts.

cvd_spot.title: CVD Spot
cvd_spot.what_measures: Cumulative signed aggressive volume in the spot market, rendered as OHLC CVD candles.
cvd_spot.price_relation: Rising CVD means spot buyers have dominated aggressive flow; falling CVD means spot sellers dominate.
cvd_spot.cross_family_relation: Compare with price and Futures CVD to identify spot-led confirmation or divergence.
cvd_spot.interpretation: Spot CVD aligned with price is stronger cash-market confirmation; divergence can reveal absorption.

cvd_futures.title: CVD Futures / Perpetuals
cvd_futures.what_measures: Cumulative signed aggressive volume in perpetual/futures markets.
cvd_futures.price_relation: Rising CVD indicates derivatives buyers crossing the spread; falling CVD indicates derivatives sellers dominating.
cvd_futures.cross_family_relation: Read with Open Interest, Funding and Liquidations to determine whether flow is leverage expansion or forced closing.
cvd_futures.interpretation: Derivatives CVD without spot confirmation can be more fragile than a spot-led move.

delta_buy_sell_spot.title: Spot Buy / Sell Flow
delta_buy_sell_spot.what_measures: Aggressive spot buy and sell notional plus net delta for the selected timeframe.
delta_buy_sell_spot.price_relation: Buy dominance supports upward pressure; sell dominance supports downward pressure.
delta_buy_sell_spot.cross_family_relation: Use with order book depth and spot CVD to see whether aggression is being absorbed.
delta_buy_sell_spot.interpretation: Net flow shows direction; gross buy/sell values show the participation behind that net result.

delta_buy_sell_futures.title: Futures / Perpetual Buy / Sell Flow
delta_buy_sell_futures.what_measures: Aggressive derivatives buy and sell notional plus net delta for the selected timeframe.
delta_buy_sell_futures.price_relation: Directional pressure is leverage-sensitive and can reverse quickly when positions unwind.
delta_buy_sell_futures.cross_family_relation: Combine with Open Interest, Funding and Liquidations.
delta_buy_sell_futures.interpretation: Strong futures flow with rising OI indicates position building; with falling OI it can reflect closing/deleveraging.

cvd_slope_acceleration.title: CVD Slope / Acceleration
cvd_slope_acceleration.what_measures: Slope of CVD and the change in that slope for the selected market/timeframe.
cvd_slope_acceleration.price_relation: Positive slope supports buyer pressure; negative slope supports seller pressure. Acceleration shows strengthening or weakening.
cvd_slope_acceleration.cross_family_relation: Compare with price momentum, OI change and flow efficiency.
cvd_slope_acceleration.interpretation: Use slope for direction and acceleration for whether the flow trend is gaining or losing force.

delta_zscore.title: Delta Z-Score
delta_zscore.what_measures: Current signed delta expressed in standard deviations from its recent baseline.
delta_zscore.price_relation: Extreme positive/negative readings identify unusually strong aggressive flow.
delta_zscore.cross_family_relation: Compare with volatility and liquidation events.
delta_zscore.interpretation: An extreme reading is a flow anomaly, not automatically a reversal or continuation signal.

buy_sell_imbalance.title: Buy / Sell Imbalance
buy_sell_imbalance.what_measures: Normalized imbalance between aggressive buying and aggressive selling.
buy_sell_imbalance.price_relation: Positive indicates buyer aggression; negative indicates seller aggression.
buy_sell_imbalance.cross_family_relation: Cross-check with liquidity depth, CVD slope and price response.
buy_sell_imbalance.interpretation: Persistent imbalance with price confirmation is stronger than a one-bar spike.

price_cvd_divergence.title: Price ↔ CVD Divergence
price_cvd_divergence.what_measures: Measures disagreement between price movement and CVD movement.
price_cvd_divergence.price_relation: Price rising while CVD weakens can indicate absorption/exhaustion; price falling while CVD strengthens can indicate hidden demand.
price_cvd_divergence.cross_family_relation: Use OI and Liquidations to identify leveraged distortions, and Liquidity to detect absorption.
price_cvd_divergence.interpretation: Divergence is a diagnostic condition that requires confirmation from market structure.

spot_futures_divergence.title: Spot ↔ Futures CVD Divergence
spot_futures_divergence.what_measures: Measures disagreement between spot and derivatives CVD.
spot_futures_divergence.price_relation: A large divergence indicates that cash and leveraged participants are pushing differently.
spot_futures_divergence.cross_family_relation: Read with Funding, OI and liquidation risk.
spot_futures_divergence.interpretation: Spot-led moves are generally more robust; futures-led divergence can signal leverage-driven fragility.

wasserstein_distance.title: Wasserstein Distance
wasserstein_distance.what_measures: Distributional distance between recent order-flow states and the preceding reference window.
wasserstein_distance.price_relation: It does not indicate direction by itself; higher values mean the flow regime has changed more materially.
wasserstein_distance.cross_family_relation: Compare with Volatility regime shifts, OI shocks and liquidity changes.
wasserstein_distance.interpretation: Rising distance flags structural change in order-flow distribution and should be interpreted with directional indicators.

open_interest_usd.title: Open Interest USD
open_interest_usd.what_measures: Total notional value of outstanding BTC derivatives positions represented by the aggregated OI feed.
open_interest_usd.price_relation: Rising OI with price expansion indicates new leveraged participation; falling OI during a large move often indicates position closure or liquidation.
open_interest_usd.cross_family_relation: Read with Funding, CVD, Liquidations and Prices to distinguish leverage build-up from deleveraging.
open_interest_usd.interpretation: OI is participation, not direction by itself. Direction comes from combining OI change with price, flow and funding.

oi_change_24h.title: OI Change 24H
oi_change_24h.what_measures: Absolute and percentage change in open interest over the preceding 24-hour horizon derived by Processing.
oi_change_24h.price_relation: Price and OI rising together suggests position build-up; price moving while OI falls suggests closing/deleveraging.
oi_change_24h.cross_family_relation: Compare with realized liquidations and CVD to identify whether the OI reduction was forced or voluntary.
oi_change_24h.interpretation: Use the sign and magnitude as a participation-change diagnostic, not a standalone long/short signal.

oi_funding_state.title: OI Funding State
oi_funding_state.what_measures: Joint classification of open-interest behavior and the current funding regime.
oi_funding_state.price_relation: Crowded positive funding with expanding OI can increase long-liquidation risk; strongly negative funding with expanding OI can increase short-squeeze risk.
oi_funding_state.cross_family_relation: Use with Liquidations and CVD for crowding confirmation.
oi_funding_state.interpretation: The state summarizes leverage pressure and crowding rather than predicting direction by itself.

provider_availability.title: Provider Availability
provider_availability.what_measures: Availability of the contracted OI/Funding primitives used by Processing.
provider_availability.price_relation: It has no directional market meaning; it is a data-quality indicator.
provider_availability.cross_family_relation: Use it to judge whether cross-family conclusions have complete provider coverage.
provider_availability.interpretation: Incomplete provider coverage should lower confidence in derived signals.

funding_rate.title: Funding Rate
funding_rate.what_measures: Open-interest-weighted perpetual funding rate from CoinGlass.
funding_rate.price_relation: Persistently positive funding indicates longs paying shorts; negative funding indicates shorts paying longs. Extreme crowding can precede squeezes.
funding_rate.cross_family_relation: Combine with OI growth, CVD and Liquidations to identify leveraged crowding.
funding_rate.interpretation: Near-zero funding is neutral. Extremes matter most when OI is also expanding.

estimated_leverage_ratio.title: Estimated Leverage Ratio
estimated_leverage_ratio.what_measures: Glassnode estimated leverage ratio used as the contracted secondary leverage confirmation.
estimated_leverage_ratio.price_relation: Higher leverage can amplify both continuation and forced reversals.
estimated_leverage_ratio.cross_family_relation: Read with OI, Funding and liquidation pressure.
estimated_leverage_ratio.interpretation: Treat elevated leverage as fragility/risk context, not direction.

open_interest_ohlc.title: Open Interest OHLC
open_interest_ohlc.what_measures: Aggregated open-interest OHLC for the selected 5m, 15m or 4h timeframe, with precomputed overlays and cross events.
open_interest_ohlc.price_relation: OI expansion/contraction reveals whether a price move is attracting new leverage or closing existing positions.
open_interest_ohlc.cross_family_relation: Use with Price OHLC, CVD and Liquidations for directional context.
open_interest_ohlc.interpretation: Arrows mark precomputed moving-average crosses in OI; they are context markers, not HMI-calculated trading signals.

oi_dynamics.title: OI ROC / Slope / Acceleration
oi_dynamics.what_measures: Rate of change, slope and acceleration of OI computed over the current timeframe.
oi_dynamics.price_relation: Acceleration in OI can reveal rapidly increasing leverage behind a price move.
oi_dynamics.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD impulse and liquidation intensity.
oi_dynamics.interpretation: Positive acceleration means leverage is building faster; negative acceleration means participation is decelerating or contracting.

oi_zscore_percentile.title: OI Z-Score / Percentile
oi_zscore_percentile.what_measures: Standardized and percentile position of OI versus its recent distribution.
oi_zscore_percentile.price_relation: Extreme OI readings can indicate unusual leverage concentration and greater squeeze sensitivity.
oi_zscore_percentile.cross_family_relation: Use with Funding and Liquidations to determine whether the extreme is crowded.
oi_zscore_percentile.interpretation: Extreme does not mean reversal automatically; it identifies abnormal positioning.

price_oi_regime.title: Price × OI Regime
price_oi_regime.what_measures: Joint regime classification from price behavior and open-interest change.
price_oi_regime.price_relation: Separates leveraged expansion, short covering, deleveraging and other price/OI combinations.
price_oi_regime.cross_family_relation: Validate with CVD direction and liquidation side.
price_oi_regime.interpretation: Use the regime label to understand the mechanism behind the price move.

price_oi_divergence.title: Price ↔ OI Divergence
price_oi_divergence.what_measures: Degree of disagreement between price movement and OI participation.
price_oi_divergence.price_relation: A large move with falling OI often reflects closing/deleveraging rather than new directional conviction.
price_oi_divergence.cross_family_relation: Use CVD and Liquidations to distinguish covering from forced exits.
price_oi_divergence.interpretation: Divergence is diagnostic context and requires flow confirmation.

funding_oi_crowding.title: Funding × OI Crowding
funding_oi_crowding.what_measures: Joint crowding score combining funding conditions with open-interest positioning.
funding_oi_crowding.price_relation: High positive crowding increases long-liquidation vulnerability; negative crowding can create short-squeeze vulnerability.
funding_oi_crowding.cross_family_relation: Confirm with liquidation clusters and CVD.
funding_oi_crowding.interpretation: Crowding measures fragility, not guaranteed reversal.

wasserstein_distance.title: Wasserstein / Regime Shift
wasserstein_distance.what_measures: Distributional distance between recent and reference OI-return windows.
wasserstein_distance.price_relation: It is non-directional; larger distance means the positioning process changed materially.
wasserstein_distance.cross_family_relation: Compare with Prices and Volatility Wasserstein plus liquidation shocks.
wasserstein_distance.interpretation: A rising distance flags an OI regime transition that should be interpreted with directional indicators.

etf_net_flow.title: ETF Net Flow
etf_net_flow.what_measures: Net USD capital entering or leaving U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs over the selected 7D or 30D range.
etf_net_flow.price_relation: Persistent positive ETF flow can support spot demand; persistent outflow can remove structural bid support, although price may diverge in the short term.
etf_net_flow.cross_family_relation: Compare with Prices, CVD and Exchange Flows to separate institutional demand from exchange-side selling pressure.
etf_net_flow.interpretation: Positive means aggregate creations/inflows dominate; negative means redemptions/outflows dominate.

total_aum.title: Total ETF AUM
total_aum.what_measures: Aggregate assets under management across the ETF catalog, derived from the contracted CoinGlass ETF list.
total_aum.price_relation: AUM generally rises with both BTC price and net creations, so changes should not be interpreted as pure flow.
total_aum.cross_family_relation: Use together with ETF Net Flow and BTC price to distinguish valuation effects from new capital.
total_aum.interpretation: A larger AUM base indicates greater institutional exposure; direction requires the flow series.

cumulative_etf_net_flow.title: Cumulative ETF Net Flow
cumulative_etf_net_flow.what_measures: Running cumulative USD ETF flow calculated by Processing from the daily CoinGlass ETF flow primitive.
cumulative_etf_net_flow.price_relation: A rising cumulative curve indicates sustained institutional accumulation pressure; a falling curve indicates sustained distribution.
cumulative_etf_net_flow.cross_family_relation: Compare its slope with Price and CVD for confirmation or divergence.
cumulative_etf_net_flow.interpretation: Focus on trend and inflection rather than the absolute starting level.

exchange_inflow.title: Exchange Inflow
exchange_inflow.what_measures: BTC transferred into exchanges over the latest 24-hour window from CryptoQuant inflow data.
exchange_inflow.price_relation: Elevated inflow can increase immediately available sell-side inventory, but transfers are not automatically sales.
exchange_inflow.cross_family_relation: Confirm with Exchange Outflow, Net Flow, CVD and Liquidations.
exchange_inflow.interpretation: Use spikes as potential distribution/liquidity-supply events that need flow confirmation.

exchange_outflow.title: Exchange Outflow
exchange_outflow.what_measures: BTC transferred out of exchanges over the latest 24-hour window from CryptoQuant outflow data.
exchange_outflow.price_relation: Persistent outflow can reduce readily available exchange supply and often accompanies custody/accumulation behavior.
exchange_outflow.cross_family_relation: Read against Net Flow, Reserve and ETF Flow to distinguish exchange withdrawal from institutional ETF demand.
exchange_outflow.interpretation: Large outflow is constructive supply context, not a standalone buy signal.

exchange_balance.title: Exchange Reserve
exchange_balance.what_measures: Latest BTC reserve held on exchanges from the contracted CryptoQuant reserve primitive.
exchange_balance.price_relation: Falling reserve can indicate declining liquid supply; rising reserve can indicate more BTC available on exchanges.
exchange_balance.cross_family_relation: Combine with inflow/outflow pressure and Price to interpret whether reserve changes are accumulation or distribution.
exchange_balance.interpretation: Trend matters more than one observation. Sudden reserve jumps should be read with transfer flows.

gbtc_premium.title: GBTC Premium / Discount
gbtc_premium.what_measures: Current GBTC premium or discount available inside the contracted ETF catalog snapshot.
gbtc_premium.price_relation: A discount can reflect weaker relative demand for GBTC shares; a premium indicates stronger relative share demand versus NAV.
gbtc_premium.cross_family_relation: Use with aggregate ETF flows and AUM rather than as a standalone BTC directional indicator.
gbtc_premium.interpretation: Values near zero mean trading near NAV; sign and magnitude show relative share/NAV dislocation.

exchange_flow_pressure.title: Exchange Flow Pressure
exchange_flow_pressure.what_measures: Normalized Processing ratio (inflow − outflow) / (inflow + outflow) over 24 hours.
exchange_flow_pressure.price_relation: Positive pressure means net transfer pressure toward exchanges; negative pressure means net withdrawal pressure.
exchange_flow_pressure.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD and Price to see whether transfer pressure translates into executed selling or buying.
exchange_flow_pressure.interpretation: Near zero is balanced; large absolute values indicate directional transfer imbalance.

etf_flow_daily.title: ETF Daily Net Flow
etf_flow_daily.what_measures: Daily aggregate U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF net flow and its selected 7D/30D display window.
etf_flow_daily.price_relation: Sustained inflow can act as structural spot demand; sustained outflow can weaken that bid.
etf_flow_daily.cross_family_relation: Compare with BTC price and CVD for flow/price confirmation.
etf_flow_daily.interpretation: Clusters of same-sign days are more informative than a single isolated session.

etf-funds.title: ETF Flow by Provider
etf-funds.what_measures: Per-fund AUM and selected-period flow across the ETF catalog.
etf-funds.price_relation: Shows which products are driving aggregate institutional demand or redemptions.
etf-funds.cross_family_relation: Use with aggregate ETF Net Flow and Total AUM.
etf-funds.interpretation: Concentration in one fund can make aggregate flow less broad than it appears.

exchange_net_flow.title: Exchange Inflow / Outflow / Net Flow
exchange_net_flow.what_measures: Daily exchange inflow and outflow plus Net Flow derived by Processing as Inflow − Outflow.
exchange_net_flow.price_relation: Positive net flow indicates more BTC entering exchanges than leaving; negative net flow indicates net withdrawal.
exchange_net_flow.cross_family_relation: Confirm with CVD, exchange reserve and liquidation pressure.
exchange_net_flow.interpretation: The net series is derived from the two contracted primitives; HMI performs no calculation.

exchange_balance.title: Exchange Balance / Reserve
exchange_balance.what_measures: Daily CryptoQuant exchange reserve history rendered directly from Processing.
exchange_balance.price_relation: A sustained decline can tighten liquid exchange supply; sustained growth can increase available inventory.
exchange_balance.cross_family_relation: Read with Net Flow and ETF institutional flow for broader capital migration.
exchange_balance.interpretation: Look for persistent reserve trend and abrupt level changes.

etf_flow_momentum_persistence.title: ETF Flow Momentum / Persistence
etf_flow_momentum_persistence.what_measures: Z-scored flow momentum plus rolling sign persistence derived from ETF daily flow.
etf_flow_momentum_persistence.price_relation: Persistent positive momentum supports institutional accumulation context; persistent negative momentum supports distribution context.
etf_flow_momentum_persistence.cross_family_relation: Confirm with BTC Price trend and CVD.
etf_flow_momentum_persistence.interpretation: Momentum measures acceleration; persistence measures whether the sign is sustained.

etf_flow_zscore.title: ETF Flow Z-Score
etf_flow_zscore.what_measures: Standardized ETF flow relative to its recent rolling distribution.
etf_flow_zscore.price_relation: Extreme positive/negative values identify unusually strong institutional demand/redemption episodes.
etf_flow_zscore.cross_family_relation: Compare with volatility and price regime to judge whether the flow is exceptional for current conditions.
etf_flow_zscore.interpretation: Magnitude measures abnormality, sign measures inflow versus outflow.

btc_etf_flow_divergence.title: BTC Price ↔ ETF Flow Divergence
btc_etf_flow_divergence.what_measures: Difference between standardized BTC return and standardized ETF flow using daily price context supplied by Prices.
btc_etf_flow_divergence.price_relation: Large divergence means price action and institutional ETF flow are not confirming each other.
btc_etf_flow_divergence.cross_family_relation: Use CVD as a third confirmation layer.
btc_etf_flow_divergence.interpretation: Divergence is diagnostic; persistence is more important than one point.

exchange_flow_pressure.title: Exchange Flow Pressure
exchange_flow_pressure.what_measures: Daily normalized exchange transfer pressure together with Net Flow Z-score.
exchange_flow_pressure.price_relation: Positive pressure can precede higher sell-side availability; negative pressure can indicate withdrawal/accumulation.
exchange_flow_pressure.cross_family_relation: Read with CVD and reserve change.
exchange_flow_pressure.interpretation: Use extremes and persistence, not small fluctuations around zero.

exchange_reserve_change.title: Exchange Reserve Change / Z-Score
exchange_reserve_change.what_measures: Standardized reserve change and longer-horizon reserve rate-of-change.
exchange_reserve_change.price_relation: Sharp reserve increases can indicate inventory moving onto exchanges; declines can indicate supply leaving exchanges.
exchange_reserve_change.cross_family_relation: Confirm with inflow/outflow and on-chain transfer context.
exchange_reserve_change.interpretation: Z-score identifies abnormal reserve moves; ROC provides structural direction.

capital_regime_wasserstein.title: ETF × Exchange Capital Regime / Wasserstein
capital_regime_wasserstein.what_measures: Composite capital-flow regime score plus Wasserstein distance between consecutive distributions of that score.
capital_regime_wasserstein.price_relation: Wasserstein is non-directional: larger distance indicates the capital-flow process itself is changing.
capital_regime_wasserstein.cross_family_relation: Compare regime shifts with Prices and Volatility Wasserstein signals.
capital_regime_wasserstein.interpretation: Use the regime score for direction and Wasserstein for transition intensity.

miner_pressure.title: Miner Pressure
miner_pressure.what_measures: Composite miner selling-pressure state built in Processing from reserve changes, SOPR and miner-transfer context.
miner_pressure.price_relation: Higher selling pressure can add supply to the market and become bearish when price demand is not strong enough to absorb it.
miner_pressure.cross_family_relation: Confirm with CVD, Exchange Flows and Liquidations to determine whether miner distribution is being absorbed or amplifying downside.
miner_pressure.interpretation: Low means limited distribution pressure; moderate means watch confirmation; high means miner-side supply is unusually strong.

reserve_trend.title: Miner Reserve Trend
reserve_trend.what_measures: Direction and slope of BTC held by miner entities over the selected window.
reserve_trend.price_relation: Falling reserves indicate net distribution; rising reserves indicate accumulation or reduced selling.
reserve_trend.cross_family_relation: Compare with Miner Net Position Change, SOPR and exchange inflows.
reserve_trend.interpretation: Persistent direction matters more than a one-day move; stronger negative slope means faster reserve depletion.

net_position.title: Miner Net Position
net_position.what_measures: Daily change in miner reserve, derived in Processing from the contracted reserve primitive.
net_position.price_relation: Negative values indicate miners are reducing holdings; positive values indicate net accumulation.
net_position.cross_family_relation: Use with Miner Pressure and CVD to judge whether miner distribution is reaching the market aggressively.
net_position.interpretation: Large negative values are distribution events; large positive values are accumulation events.

sopr_regime.title: SOPR Regime
sopr_regime.what_measures: Whether spent BTC is moving at aggregate profit or loss relative to its acquisition value.
sopr_regime.price_relation: SOPR above 1 reflects realized profit; below 1 reflects realized loss and can identify stress or capitulation.
sopr_regime.cross_family_relation: Combine with reserve change, miner pressure and volatility regime.
sopr_regime.interpretation: The 1.0 line is break-even. Persistence around or across it is more meaningful than a single observation.

miner_reserve.title: Miner Reserve
miner_reserve.what_measures: BTC balance attributed to miner entities from Glassnode.
miner_reserve.price_relation: A persistent decline can represent structural miner distribution; a rise can represent retention or accumulation.
miner_reserve.cross_family_relation: Compare with Net Position Change, miner transfers and exchange inflows.
miner_reserve.interpretation: Read slope and acceleration, not absolute level alone.

sopr_7d.title: SOPR 7D
sopr_7d.what_measures: Seven-day smoothed spent-output profit ratio used to reduce daily noise.
sopr_7d.price_relation: Values above 1 indicate realized profit; below 1 indicate realized loss.
sopr_7d.cross_family_relation: Confirm with Price trend and Volatility before interpreting capitulation or profit-taking.
sopr_7d.interpretation: Crosses and persistence around 1 are the primary reference.

hashrate.title: Hashrate
hashrate.what_measures: Estimated Bitcoin network hash rate, representing aggregate mining computation.
hashrate.price_relation: Sustained hashrate contraction can indicate miner stress; expansion usually indicates stronger network participation.
hashrate.cross_family_relation: Read with Difficulty and miner revenue stress.
hashrate.interpretation: Trend and moving-average relationships are more useful than one observation.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.what_measures: Bitcoin mining difficulty required to produce blocks.
difficulty.price_relation: Rising difficulty increases miner cost pressure when revenue does not keep pace; falling difficulty can follow miner exits.
difficulty.cross_family_relation: Combine with Hashrate, revenue stress and miner reserve behavior.
difficulty.interpretation: Use changes around difficulty adjustments as structural mining-cost context.

miner_net_position_change.title: Miner Net Position Change
miner_net_position_change.what_measures: Day-to-day change in miner BTC reserves derived by Processing.
miner_net_position_change.price_relation: Negative values add distribution context; positive values indicate retention or accumulation.
miner_net_position_change.cross_family_relation: Confirm large changes with Miner Pressure, CVD and Exchange Inflow.
miner_net_position_change.interpretation: Magnitude and persistence determine whether the move is structural or isolated.

miner_reserve_change_zscore.title: Miner Reserve Change / Z-Score
miner_reserve_change_zscore.what_measures: Reserve change together with its standardized deviation from recent behavior.
miner_reserve_change_zscore.price_relation: Strong negative z-scores identify unusually large distribution; positive extremes identify unusual accumulation.
miner_reserve_change_zscore.cross_family_relation: Use with Exchange Flow Pressure and CVD.
miner_reserve_change_zscore.interpretation: Z-score measures abnormality; reserve change supplies direction.

miner_selling_pressure.title: MPI / Miner-to-Exchange Pressure
miner_selling_pressure.what_measures: Miner Position Index and transfer-pressure context quantifying abnormal miner distribution toward the market.
miner_selling_pressure.price_relation: High positive pressure can increase downside supply when spot demand is weak.
miner_selling_pressure.cross_family_relation: Confirm with Exchange Inflow, CVD and Liquidations.
miner_selling_pressure.interpretation: Persistent extremes matter more than small oscillations near neutral.

puell_revenue_stress.title: Puell Multiple / Revenue Stress
puell_revenue_stress.what_measures: Miner revenue relative to its longer-term baseline and the resulting economic stress state.
puell_revenue_stress.price_relation: Very low revenue multiples can accompany miner stress/capitulation; high multiples can encourage profit taking.
puell_revenue_stress.cross_family_relation: Read with Hashrate, Difficulty and reserve distribution.
puell_revenue_stress.interpretation: Use extremes as miner-economics regime context, not a standalone timing signal.

hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.title: Hashrate Momentum / Hash Ribbon
hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.what_measures: Hashrate momentum and fast/slow mining-network averages used to identify contraction and recovery.
hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.price_relation: Sustained contraction can accompany miner capitulation; recovery can confirm normalization after stress.
hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.cross_family_relation: Combine with Difficulty Stress and miner reserve behavior.
hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.interpretation: Focus on persistent fast/slow relationships and momentum direction.

hashrate_difficulty_stress.title: Hashrate × Difficulty Stress
hashrate_difficulty_stress.what_measures: Joint standardized changes in hashrate and difficulty summarized as network stress.
hashrate_difficulty_stress.price_relation: Falling hashrate with high or rising difficulty can increase miner economic pressure.
hashrate_difficulty_stress.cross_family_relation: Confirm with Puell/Revenue Stress and Miner Selling Pressure.
hashrate_difficulty_stress.interpretation: Higher stress means mining conditions are deteriorating relative to recent history.

miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.title: Capitulation / Recovery + Wasserstein
miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.what_measures: Composite miner regime score, capitulation probability, recovery score and Wasserstein distance between consecutive regime distributions.
miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.price_relation: The regime score supplies direction; a larger Wasserstein distance signals that miner behavior is changing structurally.
miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.cross_family_relation: Compare regime shifts with Price and Volatility Wasserstein to detect synchronized transitions.
miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.interpretation: Use probability/recovery for state and Wasserstein for transition intensity; Wasserstein itself is non-directional.

current_regime.title: Current Regime
current_regime.what_measures: Current realized-volatility regime classified from the recent empirical distribution.
current_regime.price_relation: The regime describes movement magnitude rather than bullish or bearish direction.
current_regime.cross_family_relation: Compare with Prices Wasserstein, OI deleveraging and liquidation pressure to confirm regime transitions.
current_regime.interpretation: LOW means compressed realized volatility, NORMAL is the middle distribution and HIGH means unusually elevated volatility.

realized_vol_7d.title: Realized Volatility 7D
realized_vol_7d.what_measures: Annualized volatility derived by Processing from BTC spot returns over a rolling seven-day window.
realized_vol_7d.price_relation: Higher values mean BTC has been moving through a wider realized return distribution.
realized_vol_7d.cross_family_relation: Compare with DVOL to estimate the volatility risk premium and with liquidity stress to judge whether movement is disorderly.
realized_vol_7d.interpretation: Rising RV7D indicates expanding realized movement; falling RV7D indicates compression.

implied_vol_dvol.title: Implied Volatility / DVOL
implied_vol_dvol.what_measures: Glassnode DVOL close, the only external volatility primitive used by this family.
implied_vol_dvol.price_relation: It reflects option-implied uncertainty, not price direction.
implied_vol_dvol.cross_family_relation: Compare with realized volatility to see whether options price more or less movement than BTC is currently realizing.
implied_vol_dvol.interpretation: A rising DVOL means the options market is pricing greater future uncertainty.

vol_risk_premium.title: Volatility Risk Premium
vol_risk_premium.what_measures: Difference between 1M implied volatility and 30D realized volatility.
vol_risk_premium.price_relation: Positive VRP means implied volatility exceeds realized volatility; negative VRP means realized volatility is richer.
vol_risk_premium.cross_family_relation: Useful with liquidation pressure and liquidity stress to distinguish priced fear from realized disorder.
vol_risk_premium.interpretation: Large positive values imply options carry a volatility premium; negative values indicate realized movement outrunning implied pricing.

skew_25d.title: 25Δ Skew
skew_25d.what_measures: Processing-derived downside versus upside implied-volatility asymmetry around the DVOL state.
skew_25d.price_relation: Positive values indicate richer downside protection; negative values indicate richer upside optionality.
skew_25d.cross_family_relation: Compare with positioning, liquidation clusters and ETF flows for asymmetric risk demand.
skew_25d.interpretation: Use the sign for asymmetry and magnitude for strength; it is not a direct directional signal.

regime_confidence.title: Regime Confidence
regime_confidence.what_measures: Distance of the current realized-volatility percentile from the middle of its recent distribution.
regime_confidence.price_relation: Higher confidence means the current volatility state is more clearly separated from the median regime.
regime_confidence.cross_family_relation: Confirm strong readings with Wasserstein shifts and market-stress families.
regime_confidence.interpretation: High confidence strengthens the regime label; low confidence means the state is close to normal.

realized_volatility.title: Realized Volatility · RV7D / RV30D
realized_volatility.what_measures: Rolling 7D and 30D annualized realized volatility derived from Prices.
realized_volatility.price_relation: Shows how violently BTC has actually moved over short and medium horizons.
realized_volatility.cross_family_relation: Compare against DVOL and liquidity conditions.
realized_volatility.interpretation: RV7D above RV30D indicates recent volatility expansion; below it indicates recent compression.

implied_volatility.title: Implied Volatility · DVOL / IV1M
implied_volatility.what_measures: Native DVOL plus the 1M implied-volatility display transform produced by Processing.
implied_volatility.price_relation: Represents priced future uncertainty rather than spot direction.
implied_volatility.cross_family_relation: Compare with RV and OI/liquidations during leveraged stress.
implied_volatility.interpretation: A widening gap versus realized volatility indicates a richer implied premium.

implied_vs_realized.title: Implied vs Realized / VRP
implied_vs_realized.what_measures: Direct comparison of 1M implied volatility, RV30D and their volatility risk premium.
implied_vs_realized.price_relation: Highlights whether the options market is pricing more or less movement than spot has realized.
implied_vs_realized.cross_family_relation: Useful with ETF flows and liquidation pressure around risk events.
implied_vs_realized.interpretation: Positive VRP means implied exceeds realized; negative VRP means realized exceeds implied.

term_structure.title: IV Term Structure
term_structure.what_measures: Processing-derived 1W, 1M, 3M and 6M implied-volatility maturities anchored to DVOL.
term_structure.price_relation: The slope describes how uncertainty is priced through time, not spot direction.
term_structure.cross_family_relation: Compare inversions/steepening with liquidation stress and regime shifts.
term_structure.interpretation: Front-end richness can signal near-term event risk; upward slope indicates more volatility priced farther out.

volatility_zscore_percentile.title: Volatility Z-Score / Percentile
volatility_zscore_percentile.what_measures: Standardized RV7D deviation and empirical percentile within its recent distribution.
volatility_zscore_percentile.price_relation: Extreme readings mean movement magnitude is statistically unusual, not inherently bullish or bearish.
volatility_zscore_percentile.cross_family_relation: Compare with price regime, liquidation intensity and liquidity stress.
volatility_zscore_percentile.interpretation: High percentile/z-score indicates volatility expansion; low values indicate compression.

volatility_risk_premium.title: Volatility Risk Premium
volatility_risk_premium.what_measures: IV1M minus RV30D plus its rolling z-score.
volatility_risk_premium.price_relation: Quantifies how richly or cheaply future movement is priced versus recent realized movement.
volatility_risk_premium.cross_family_relation: Compare with options positioning, OI and stress events.
volatility_risk_premium.interpretation: Positive/high z-score means implied volatility is relatively expensive; negative means realized volatility dominates.

term_structure_slope.title: IV Term Structure / Slope
term_structure_slope.what_measures: Slope and curvature of the Processing-derived 1W/1M/3M/6M volatility curve.
term_structure_slope.price_relation: Describes temporal risk pricing rather than price direction.
term_structure_slope.cross_family_relation: Use with regime shifts and event/liquidation risk.
term_structure_slope.interpretation: Steeper or inverted structures reveal where the options market concentrates uncertainty.

volatility_skew_tail_risk.title: Volatility Skew / Tail Risk
volatility_skew_tail_risk.what_measures: Downside versus upside implied-volatility asymmetry and 25Δ skew proxy.
volatility_skew_tail_risk.price_relation: Richer downside IV indicates stronger demand for downside protection; richer upside IV indicates upside convexity demand.
volatility_skew_tail_risk.cross_family_relation: Compare with long/short crowding, liquidations and ETF flows.
volatility_skew_tail_risk.interpretation: Focus on asymmetry and changes in skew, not the absolute price direction alone.

vol_of_vol_acceleration.title: Vol-of-Vol / Acceleration
vol_of_vol_acceleration.what_measures: Change in DVOL itself plus acceleration of RV7D.
vol_of_vol_acceleration.price_relation: Rising values indicate volatility is becoming more unstable or expanding faster.
vol_of_vol_acceleration.cross_family_relation: Useful with liquidity deterioration and liquidation cascades.
vol_of_vol_acceleration.interpretation: High vol-of-vol and positive acceleration are stress/transition signatures.

regime_shift_wasserstein.title: Regime Shift / Wasserstein
regime_shift_wasserstein.what_measures: Normalized 1-D Wasserstein distance between the previous 7-day RV7D distribution and the current 7-day RV7D distribution.
regime_shift_wasserstein.price_relation: It is non-directional: a larger distance means the statistical volatility regime is changing, not that price must rise or fall.
regime_shift_wasserstein.cross_family_relation: Compare with Prices Wasserstein, OI deleveraging, liquidation pressure and liquidity stress for synchronized regime shifts.
regime_shift_wasserstein.interpretation: Near zero means consecutive volatility distributions are similar; rising distance indicates a stronger distributional transition. The companion transition percentage scales that shift intensity.

long_short_ratio.title: Long/Short Ratio
long_short_ratio.price_relation: Summarizes current liquidation pressure or nearby forced-liquidation risk around BTC price.
long_short_ratio.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
long_short_ratio.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

liquidation_regime.title: Liquidation Regime
liquidation_regime.price_relation: Summarizes current liquidation pressure or nearby forced-liquidation risk around BTC price.
liquidation_regime.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
liquidation_regime.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

pressure_score.title: Pressure Score
pressure_score.price_relation: Summarizes current liquidation pressure or nearby forced-liquidation risk around BTC price.
pressure_score.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
pressure_score.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

pressure_label.title: Pressure Label
pressure_label.price_relation: Summarizes current liquidation pressure or nearby forced-liquidation risk around BTC price.
pressure_label.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
pressure_label.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

dominant_side.price_relation: Summarizes current liquidation pressure or nearby forced-liquidation risk around BTC price.
dominant_side.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
dominant_side.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

top_exchange_concentration.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
top_exchange_concentration.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

max_event_spike.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
max_event_spike.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

max_single_liquidation.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
max_single_liquidation.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

nearest_long_cluster.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
nearest_long_cluster.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

nearest_short_cluster.title: Nearest Short Cluster
nearest_short_cluster.price_relation: Summarizes current liquidation pressure or nearby forced-liquidation risk around BTC price.
nearest_short_cluster.cross_family_relation: Read with Prices, OI/Funding, CVD and Liquidity for confirmation.
nearest_short_cluster.interpretation: Use as a compact state summary; the HMI only displays the Processing result.

hyperliquid_map.title: Hyperliquid BTC Liquidation Map
hyperliquid_map.what_measures: Estimated liquidation concentration by BTC price level for Hyperliquid using the CoinGlass pair liquidation map primitive.
hyperliquid_map.price_relation: Dense levels near spot can act as liquidation magnets; a move into them can accelerate forced position closure.
hyperliquid_map.cross_family_relation: Compare with Open Interest, Funding, CVD and Liquidity to judge whether leverage and order flow support a cascade.
hyperliquid_map.interpretation: Clusters below price represent estimated long-liquidation zones; clusters above price represent estimated short-liquidation zones.

exchange_maps.title: BTC Exchange Liquidation Maps
exchange_maps.what_measures: Aggregated liquidation-map intensity across supported exchanges by BTC price level.
exchange_maps.price_relation: Large concentrated zones can mark areas where price movement may trigger cascading liquidations.
exchange_maps.cross_family_relation: Use with Open Interest and Funding for leverage buildup and with CVD for directional pressure.
exchange_maps.interpretation: Higher bars indicate stronger estimated liquidation concentration at that price region.

binance_map.title: Binance BTC/USDT Liquidation Map
binance_map.what_measures: Estimated Binance BTC/USDT liquidation concentration by price level from the pair liquidation map primitive.
binance_map.price_relation: Approaching a dense Binance cluster can increase the probability of forced-liquidation acceleration.
binance_map.cross_family_relation: Compare with Binance positioning, OI/Funding and liquidity depth.
binance_map.interpretation: Below-price clusters correspond to long liquidation risk; above-price clusters correspond to short liquidation risk.

long_short_positioning.title: Long / Short Positioning
long_short_positioning.what_measures: Canonical Global Account long/short ratio for the selected exchange and timeframe.
long_short_positioning.price_relation: Extreme positioning can increase squeeze risk when price moves against the crowded side.
long_short_positioning.cross_family_relation: Use with liquidation intensity, OI/Funding and CVD; positioning is not realized liquidation flow.
long_short_positioning.interpretation: Ratio above 1 means more long than short accounts; below 1 means more short than long accounts.

liquidation_intensity_zscore.title: Liquidation Intensity / Z-Score
liquidation_intensity_zscore.what_measures: Processing-native liquidation analysis series for this panel.
liquidation_intensity_zscore.price_relation: Shows how liquidation activity and positioning co-move with BTC price and stress.
liquidation_intensity_zscore.cross_family_relation: Confirm with Prices, Open Interest/Funding, CVD and Volatility.
liquidation_intensity_zscore.interpretation: Use direction, magnitude and regime shifts rather than isolated points; warm-up gaps are valid missing history, not zero.

long_short_liquidation_imbalance.what_measures: Processing-native liquidation analysis series for this panel.
long_short_liquidation_imbalance.price_relation: Shows how liquidation activity and positioning co-move with BTC price and stress.
long_short_liquidation_imbalance.cross_family_relation: Confirm with Prices, Open Interest/Funding, CVD and Volatility.
long_short_liquidation_imbalance.interpretation: Use direction, magnitude and regime shifts rather than isolated points; warm-up gaps are valid missing history, not zero.

crowding_liquidation_pressure.cross_family_relation: Confirm with Prices, Open Interest/Funding, CVD and Volatility.
crowding_liquidation_pressure.interpretation: Use direction, magnitude and regime shifts rather than isolated points; warm-up gaps are valid missing history, not zero.

liquidation_regime_hmi.title: Liquidation Regime / Wasserstein
liquidation_regime_hmi.what_measures: Processing-native liquidation analysis series for this panel.
liquidation_regime_hmi.price_relation: Shows how liquidation activity and positioning co-move with BTC price and stress.
liquidation_regime_hmi.cross_family_relation: Confirm with Prices, Open Interest/Funding, CVD and Volatility.
liquidation_regime_hmi.interpretation: Use direction, magnitude and regime shifts rather than isolated points; warm-up gaps are valid missing history, not zero.

bid_depth.title: Bid Depth
bid_depth.what_measures: Visible resting bid liquidity inside the contractual 10% depth window.
bid_depth.price_relation: More bid depth can cushion downward market orders; abrupt loss can increase downside slippage.
bid_depth.cross_family_relation: Confirm with order-book imbalance, whale persistence, CVD and realized volatility.
bid_depth.interpretation: Read level and change together; large depth is supportive only while it persists.

ask_depth.title: Ask Depth
ask_depth.what_measures: Visible resting ask liquidity inside the contractual 10% depth window.
ask_depth.price_relation: More ask depth can resist upward market orders; abrupt withdrawal can open an upside vacuum.
ask_depth.cross_family_relation: Confirm with order-book imbalance, whale persistence, CVD and liquidation clusters.
ask_depth.interpretation: Compare against bid depth and watch cancellations before treating a wall as durable.

spread.title: Spread
spread.what_measures: Distance between the best visible bid and ask.
spread.price_relation: Wider spreads increase execution friction and often accompany stressed or thin conditions.
spread.cross_family_relation: Read with market impact, volatility and order-flow intensity.
spread.interpretation: A widening spread with rising impact is stronger evidence of liquidity deterioration than spread alone.

liquidity_imbalance.title: Liquidity Imbalance
liquidity_imbalance.what_measures: Normalized asymmetry between visible bid and ask depth.
liquidity_imbalance.price_relation: Positive imbalance indicates more bid support; negative imbalance indicates more ask-side resistance.
liquidity_imbalance.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD direction, whale orders and liquidation pressure.
liquidity_imbalance.interpretation: Persistent imbalance that agrees with executed flow is more meaningful than a single snapshot.

mid_price.title: Mid Price
mid_price.what_measures: Midpoint between the current best bid and ask used as the microstructure reference price.
mid_price.price_relation: It anchors distance-to-book, whale-order distance and local execution context around BTC.
mid_price.cross_family_relation: Compare with Prices OHLCV; small differences are normal because this is book-derived.
mid_price.interpretation: Use as a reference coordinate, not as a standalone trading signal.

impact_1_btc.title: Impact 1 BTC
impact_1_btc.what_measures: Estimated book impact of executing approximately 1 BTC against visible liquidity.
impact_1_btc.price_relation: Higher impact means the same trade can move price farther because nearby depth is thinner.
impact_1_btc.cross_family_relation: Read with spread, volatility, order-book slope and executed flow.
impact_1_btc.interpretation: Rising impact together with shrinking depth is a direct liquidity-stress warning.

order_depth.title: Order Book Depth
order_depth.what_measures: Cumulative bid and ask quantity as distance from the current mid price.
order_depth.price_relation: Thin depth near zero implies less liquidity is available to absorb immediate price movement.
order_depth.cross_family_relation: Compare with whale orders, impact, CVD and liquidation maps.
order_depth.interpretation: Look for asymmetry, cliffs and vacuums rather than only the largest total.

whale_liquidity_profile.title: Whale Orders
whale_liquidity_profile.what_measures: Large resting limit orders and their distance from the current mid price.
whale_liquidity_profile.price_relation: Persistent large bids can support price and persistent asks can cap price; cancellations can reverse that interpretation quickly.
whale_liquidity_profile.cross_family_relation: Confirm with order-book depth, whale persistence and executed absorption.
whale_liquidity_profile.interpretation: Treat a wall as meaningful only when it remains present through successive structural refreshes.

executed_liquidity_profile.title: Large Trades
executed_liquidity_profile.what_measures: Large executed footprint deltas accumulated in the fast FIFO tape.
executed_liquidity_profile.price_relation: Buy executions consume asks and sell executions consume bids, revealing where liquidity is actually being taken.
executed_liquidity_profile.cross_family_relation: Read with CVD, depth imbalance, absorption and volatility.
executed_liquidity_profile.interpretation: Focus on repeated same-side execution and whether visible depth replenishes or disappears.

executed_operations.title: Nearest Liquidity Zones
executed_operations.what_measures: The strongest nearby bid-side and ask-side liquidity zones selected by Processing from visible order-book depth and persistent whale orders.
executed_operations.price_relation: Bid liquidity below mid can act as nearby support/absorption; ask liquidity above mid can act as nearby resistance/absorption. Distance and notional show how close and how large each zone is.
executed_operations.cross_family_relation: Compare the zones with CVD, price response and liquidations to judge whether resting liquidity is absorbing flow or likely to be swept.
executed_operations.interpretation: A large persistent zone close to mid is more immediately relevant than a distant wall. The indicator selects the strongest nearby candidate on each side; it does not predict that the wall must hold.

orderbook_snapshot.title: Order Book Snapshot
orderbook_snapshot.what_measures: Current visible bid and ask levels used by the liquidity contract.
orderbook_snapshot.price_relation: The nearest levels determine immediate execution friction around BTC.
orderbook_snapshot.cross_family_relation: Read with depth profile and impact metrics.
orderbook_snapshot.interpretation: This is a snapshot; compare successive updates to separate persistent structure from fleeting orders.

whale_orders_table.title: Whale Orders Table
whale_orders_table.what_measures: Recent large resting orders with side, price, size, notional and distance from mid.
whale_orders_table.price_relation: Nearby persistent orders can attract or repel price, while rapid cancellation can expose a vacuum.
whale_orders_table.cross_family_relation: Use with whale-persistence analysis and order-book depth.
whale_orders_table.interpretation: Prioritize notional, distance and persistence together.

large_trades_table.title: Large Trades Table
large_trades_table.what_measures: Newest executed-liquidity events from the ~1 s fast lane; maximum 10 new events per cycle and FIFO 20 visible.
large_trades_table.price_relation: Shows where aggressive execution is consuming visible liquidity in real time.
large_trades_table.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD, price response, absorption and spread/impact.
large_trades_table.interpretation: Rows are deduplicated deltas, not repeated copies of the provider 500-record response.

depth_imbalance_pressure.title: Depth Imbalance / Pressure
depth_imbalance_pressure.what_measures: Historical bid/ask depth asymmetry, its z-score and depth ratio.
depth_imbalance_pressure.price_relation: Persistent positive pressure can cushion downside; persistent negative pressure can cap upside.
depth_imbalance_pressure.cross_family_relation: Read with CVD and whale-order persistence.
depth_imbalance_pressure.interpretation: Z-score identifies unusually extreme imbalance relative to recent liquidity history.

spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.title: Spread × Market Impact / Liquidity Stress
spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.what_measures: Combines spread, estimated 1-BTC impact and a normalized stress score.
spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.price_relation: High stress means price can move farther for a given aggressive order.
spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.cross_family_relation: Compare with volatility regime and large-trade execution intensity.
spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.interpretation: The strongest warning is simultaneous spread widening and impact deterioration.

liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.title: Liquidity Wall / Concentration + Vacuum
liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.what_measures: Measures concentration of visible walls and directional thin-book vacuums.
liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.price_relation: Walls may impede price; vacuums can accelerate movement once price enters a thin zone.
liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.cross_family_relation: Use with liquidation clusters and whale-order persistence.
liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.interpretation: A wall with low persistence is weaker than a smaller but stable wall.

whale_persistence_cancellation.title: Whale Persistence / Cancellation Activity
whale_persistence_cancellation.what_measures: Tracks how long large orders remain visible and how aggressively they are withdrawn.
whale_persistence_cancellation.price_relation: Persistent orders can shape local support/resistance; cancellation bursts can precede rapid repricing.
whale_persistence_cancellation.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD and order-book vacuum scores.
whale_persistence_cancellation.interpretation: Cancellation spikes weaken the informational value of displayed walls.

executed_liquidity_absorption.title: Executed Liquidity / Absorption
executed_liquidity_absorption.what_measures: Measures aggressive buy/sell execution relative to the book response and net absorption.
executed_liquidity_absorption.price_relation: High absorption means substantial execution occurs without equivalent price displacement.
executed_liquidity_absorption.cross_family_relation: Read with CVD and Prices to distinguish absorption from directional continuation.
executed_liquidity_absorption.interpretation: Strong buy absorption can mean sellers are replenishing asks; strong sell absorption can mean buyers are replenishing bids.

liquidity_regime_hmi.title: Liquidity Regime / HMI + Wasserstein
liquidity_regime_hmi.what_measures: Composite liquidity state plus Wasserstein distance between recent microstructure distributions.
liquidity_regime_hmi.price_relation: Regime displacement can signal that BTC is entering a materially different execution environment.
liquidity_regime_hmi.cross_family_relation: Compare with volatility regime, Prices and liquidation pressure.
liquidity_regime_hmi.interpretation: Wasserstein warm-up is missing data, not zero; rising distance indicates distributional change.

regime.title: Liquidity Regime
regime.price_relation: Summarizes whether execution conditions are supportive, neutral or stressed around BTC.
regime.cross_family_relation: Confirm with volatility and liquidation regimes.
regime.interpretation: Use as a state label backed by the Screen-B components, not in isolation.

depth_imbalance.title: Depth Imbalance
depth_imbalance.price_relation: Positive favors bid depth; negative favors ask depth.
depth_imbalance.cross_family_relation: Confirm with CVD and whale orders.
depth_imbalance.interpretation: Magnitude matters more when persistent across structural refreshes.

liquidity_stress.title: Liquidity Stress
liquidity_stress.price_relation: Higher values imply greater execution friction and vulnerability to price displacement.
liquidity_stress.cross_family_relation: Read with volatility and executed flow.
liquidity_stress.interpretation: Rising stress during large trades deserves more attention than an isolated spike.

absorption.title: Absorption
absorption.price_relation: Shows whether aggressive flow is being absorbed rather than immediately moving BTC.
absorption.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD and price change.
absorption.interpretation: Large flow plus small price movement implies stronger absorption.

wasserstein.title: Wasserstein
wasserstein.what_measures: Latest distribution distance between recent liquidity states.
wasserstein.price_relation: Higher values indicate a larger shift in the microstructure environment surrounding BTC.
wasserstein.cross_family_relation: Read with volatility Wasserstein/regime and liquidation regime.
wasserstein.interpretation: Use changes and persistence, not a single absolute value.
